findings.cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains
findings.explanation: Wildcard CORS is real but only on the dev-only MOCK checkpoint (port 8001, synthetic data, every response tagged mock:true, not started by Makefile/Procfile). The real checkpoint (checkpoint/app.py) allows only localhost:5173 origins.
